item.totemsexpansion.tornado_totem.desc: On lethal hit: launches nearby enemies high into the sky and grants Slow Falling.
item.totemsexpansion.fire_totem.desc: On lethal hit: deals 5 damage to nearby enemies, ignites them for 3 seconds, grants Fire Resistance.
item.totemsexpansion.cripper_totem.desc: On lethal hit: detonates a huge blast dealing massive damage to enemies. The user is immune.
